description: 白象插第八横线，切断黑方后车联系
explanation_en: White's bishop interposes on the eighth rank, separating Black's rook and bishop and winning the queen.

intro.popup: 💡 拦截：黑车在d8，黑象在f8，在第八横线协同。白象能插入e8，切断它们的联系，逼黑后妥协吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Interference: Black's rook on d8 and bishop on f8 coordinate along the eighth rank. Can White's bishop interpose on e8, break their connection, and force the queen to respond?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：先Rf1！车换位后，Bf7+引王到h8，Be8插入第八横线——黑后必须移到f7，Bxf7赢后！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: First play Rf1, then Bf7+ drives the king to h8. Be8 interferes on the eighth rank, forcing the queen to f7, where Bxf7 wins it.

moves.popup: 白车Rf1！先调车到f1，为象对角线将军做准备。
moves.popup_en: Rf1! White repositions the rook to f1, preparing a bishop check along the diagonal.

moves.popup: 黑车Rd8——退回d8，守住第八横线。
moves.popup_en: The rook retreats to d8 to defend the eighth rank.

moves.popup: 白象Bf7+！对角线将军，黑王必须到h8角落！
moves.popup_en: Bf7+! The bishop checks along the diagonal, forcing the black king into the corner on h8.

moves.popup: 黑王Kh8——王角被迫，第八横线上d8车和f8象仍在。
moves.popup_en: The king is forced to h8. Black's rook on d8 and bishop on f8 remain connected along the eighth rank.

moves.popup: 白象Be8！插入e8，切断黑Rd8与黑Bf8在第八横线的联系——黑后c7被迫应对！
moves.popup_en: Be8! The bishop interposes on e8, cutting the eighth-rank connection between the rook on d8 and bishop on f8. Black's queen on c7 must respond.

moves.popup: 黑后Qf7——被迫来应对白象，守住e8方向。
moves.popup_en: The queen is forced to f7 to meet the bishop's threat and protect the e8 direction.

moves.popup: 白象Bxf7！吃掉黑后——拦截战术完成，白方赢后！
moves.popup_en: Bxf7! The bishop captures the black queen. The interference succeeds, and White wins the queen.
